saints.name: St. Boniface
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The English monk who became the apostle of Germany, felled the sacred oak of Thor, and died a martyr in Frisia…
biography: Born Winfrid in Wessex, Boniface left the cloister to evangelize the Germanic peoples under commission from Rome. He is remembered for felling the great Oak of Thor at Geismar, which won many to the faith, and for organizing the Church across Germany, founding sees and the abbey of Fulda.
An old man, still a missionary, he was slain with his companions by pagans in Frisia while awaiting a group of converts for confirmation.
saints.knownFor: Evangelizing and organizing the Church in Germany.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 5 June
